subject: Cooper Labs
title: We turn Web3 ideas *into products people use.*
standfirst: Cooper Labs is a product studio for Web3 teams: design and engineering in one team, from the brief to the stores, with a demo of working software every Friday.

columns.heading: How we *work*
bullets: A designer and an engineer on every project from day one; the design system lives in Figma and in code.
Thirty minutes, the client in the room, the decisions written the same day.
Two or three fixed-price phases; the next one starts on a demo, not on a plan.

columns.heading: What we *don't do*
bullets: We build the product; the user signs. Nothing we ship holds funds.
A proposal names its demos; a demo shows the thing running.
Scope, price and dates per phase, written before the first week.

table.heading: Engagements, *by phase*
rows: Interviews, one flow, the cut list
